name: Mould remediation
summary: How tenants and owners handle mould in Singapore homes — humidity diagnosis, landlord vs tenant responsibility, HEPA cleaning vs paint-over, and when to call remediation pros.
body:
Tropical humidity plus AC short-cycling breeds mould on walls, silicone, and wardrobes. Quick bleach wipe-downs often fail if moisture sources remain. Remediation firms combine containment, removal, drying, and source fixes.

## Typical jobs
- Bedroom wall / ceiling patches after monsoon leaks
- Wardrobe and shoe-cabinet blooms
- Bathroom silicone and grout regrowth
- Post-leak drying and HEPA cleaning
- Moisture-meter reports for landlord disputes

Tenancy agreements and photos matter before you pay for major works.

## How to choose
Prefer firms that measure moisture and explain containment, not only “anti-mould paint.” Ask about waste disposal and whether occupants should leave during works. Get written scope separating cleaning from waterproofing repairs.

## Practical tip
Log humidity readings and photograph growth weekly before negotiating with landlord or agent — timestamps beat memory in deposit fights.
